name: lobe-calculator____calculate____builtin
description: Calculate result of a mathematical expression.

expression.description: Mathematical expression to calculate (e.g., "2 + 3 * 4", "sqrt(16)", "sin(30 deg)", "det([[1,2],[3,4]])", "5 cm to inch")

precision.description: Number of decimal places for result (optional, defaults to 10)

name: lobe-calculator____evaluate____builtin
description: Evaluate a complex mathematical expression with variable support.

precision.description: Number of decimal places for result (optional, defaults to 10)

variables.description: Key-value pairs of variables to substitute in expression (e.g., {"x": 5, "r": 3})

name: lobe-calculator____sort____builtin
description: Sort multiple numbers with flexible output options (sorted array, largest value, or smallest value).

mode.description: Optional mode: "largest" returns only largest value; "smallest" returns only smallest value; if not specified, returns sorted array

precision.description: Number of decimal places for comparison results (optional, defaults to 10)

reverse.description: Sort order: false (default) sorts ascending (smallest to largest); true sorts descending (largest to smallest)

name: lobe-calculator____base____builtin
description: Convert numbers between different number bases.

fromBase.description: Source base of the input number (numeric value between 2-36)

number.description: The number to convert (string or number, e.g., "1010", 1010, "77", "255", "FF", "Z")

toBase.description: Target base for conversion (numeric value between 2-36)

name: lobe-calculator____differentiate____builtin
description: Differentiate a mathematical expression with respect to a variable.

variable.description: Variable to differentiate with respect to (e.g., "x", "y", "t")

name: lobe-calculator____defintegrate____builtin
description: Compute definite integral of a mathematical expression with respect to a variable over a given interval.

lowerBound.description: Lower bound of integration (can be number, "0", "-infinity", etc.)

upperBound.description: Upper bound of integration (can be number, "pi", "infinity", etc.)

variable.description: Variable to integrate with respect to (e.g., "x", "y", "t")

name: lobe-calculator____integrate____builtin
description: Integrate a mathematical expression with respect to a variable (indefinite integral).

variable.description: Variable to integrate with respect to (e.g., "x", "y", "t")

name: lobe-calculator____execute____builtin
description: Execute a generic nerdamer expression for symbolic math computations.

name: lobe-calculator____limit____builtin
description: Compute the limit of a mathematical expression.

expression.description: Mathematical expression to compute limit for (e.g., "sin(x)/x", "x^2", "exp(-x)")

point.description: Point at which to evaluate the limit (optional). If not specified, computes the limit as variable approaches the expression. Can be a specific value or "infinity" (e.g., "0", "1", "infinity")

variable.description: Variable to compute limit with respect to (e.g., "x", "y", "t")

name: lobe-calculator____solve____builtin
description: Solve algebraic equations or systems of equations symbolically.

equation.description: The equation(s) to solve. Single equation (e.g., ["x^2 + 2*x + 1 = 0"]) or system of equations (e.g., ["2*x+y=5", "x-y=1"])

variable.description: Variable(s) to solve for. For single equation: array with one variable (optional, defaults to ["x"], e.g., ["x"]). For system of equations: array of variables (e.g., ["x", "y"])
